# Leave Site Button

Components · Live demo & interactive props: `/tango#/leave-site-button`

The fixed top-right exit control for site screens: a danger-red square X button with consistent placement and accessible labeling.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `onLeave` | `() => void` | yes | — | Invoked when the player leaves the site. |
| `label` | `string` | no | `Leave site` | Accessible label / tooltip. Defaults to "Leave site". |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | no | `false` | Disables the button (e.g. while an animation is committing). |
| `testId` | `string` | no | — | `data-testid` for the button. |

## Usage

```tsx
import { LeaveSiteButton } from "src/tango/components/hud/LeaveSiteButton";

<LeaveSiteButton onLeave={completeQuestSite} />
```
